Unified input matrix for AMR modeling

Source: R/training_and_test_inputfile_complete.R
training_and_test_inputfile_complete.Rd

A curated data frame combining cleaned metadata, phenotype labels, and gene-level features across both training and testing samples. Designed for downstream use in machine learning and deep learning pipelines.

Usage

training_and_test_inputfile_complete

Format

A data frame with N rows and M variables. Key columns include:

accession

SRA identifier for each sample

scientific_name_new

Standardized species name

new_genus

Genus classification used for MIC binning

phenotype_assigned

Resistance label: Susceptible, Resistant, or ? (unknown for test)

source_db

Indicates whether sample originated from training or test metadata

ARO_XXXXXXX

Binary or numeric indicators for resistance genes or SNPs derived from CARD

...

Additional metadata fields and feature annotations used in modeling

Source

Assembled from CAMDA 2025 metadata and gene family outputs from CARD-RGI
